title: Annotative Cost Notes: Prototype & Stakeholder Review
creator: Iris Chen
description: Design, prototype, and capture stakeholder feedback for a lightweight 'Annotative Cost Notes' interaction: allow users to attach short contextual notes to cost tiles and rollout timelines. Objectives are to validate interaction patterns, ensure privacy/permission affordances, and identify edge cases for truncation, sharing, and export. Acceptance criteria: 1) Click-to-add note flow prototype in Figma with microcopy; 2) Stakeholder review captured and prioritized; 3) Handoff-ready redlines and QA checklist for dev; 4) Performance/cost guardrails documented for engineering trade-offs.
comments: 2026-03-10 — Iris Chen: Initial ticket created. Sketches attached in Figma showing inline note icon, hover snippet, expanded note modal, and compact mobile flow. Emphasis on minimizing cognitive load on the cost dashboard.

2026-03-11 — Maya Patel: Converted sketches to interactive Figma prototype. Added microcopy options for 'Add note' CTA and helper tooltip text. Included keyboard-accessible flow and an empty-state guideline.

2026-03-11 — Arun Singh (PM): Suggested scope: start with per-tile notes; postpone cross-tile threaded comments until post-launch. Request to include an option to link a note to a rollout window and surface it in the rollout timeline summary.

2026-03-11 — Leila Park (Engineering): Flagged two engineering concerns: 1) storing notes inline in the same DB row could increase request payloads on bulk tile fetches; 2) search index impact for text in notes. Proposed storing notes as a separate lightweight document store with lazy-loading on tile expand.

2026-03-12 — Maya Patel: Updated prototype to lazy-load note previews and added a subtle loading skeleton. Provided two truncation strategies (ellipsis with 'View more' vs. hover preview). Added accessibility annotation for screen readers.

2026-03-12 — Jonah Rivera (Design Ops): Ran quick stakeholder run through with Growth and Customer Success. CS requested a one-click 'export notes' for customer-facing invoices and an opt-out toggle for auto-sharing notes across orgs.

2026-03-12 — QA (Paola Mendes): Created a draft QA checklist: note create/edit/delete, permission checks, rollback on failed save, UX for long text, mobile truncation, keyboard navigation, and copy/paste fidelity. Also added test for export CSV cell escaping.
2026-03-12 — Maya Patel: Preparing redlines and handoff package. Will include tokens for spacing, colors, icon assets, and interaction timing (200ms hover delay, 180ms expand animation).

2026-03-12 — Iris Chen: Summary: ready for stakeholder review today at 3 PM UTC. Follow-ups: confirm data storage approach with infra, get legal input on note persistence retention policy, and finalize microcopy for 'Share with org' vs 'Private to me'.
review_feedback: Growth (2026-03-12): Favor compact inline preview for power users to reduce clicks; ask that 'View notes' be available from keyboard-only flows.
Customer Success (2026-03-12): Strong ask for export and audit trail (who added/edited a note). Recommend adding timestamp and author metadata to note UI.
Engineering (2026-03-12): Prefer separate note document model with lazy fetch. Also request rate-limit guidance and a per-tenant quota to avoid hot partitions.
Legal (2026-03-12): Need retention policy options and ability to redact notes tied to customer requests. Flag security review if notes can contain PII.
Design Leadership (2026-03-12): Approve interaction decisions but ask to run A/B test on preview truncation strategy in the next experiment window.
